title: Chapter 1315
text:
Bang! Bang! Bang!

Countless cannons fired at the same time, bombarding the figure in the middle. Manison's consciousness turned into a silver giant and ravaged Mornisa's virtual soul.

In the territory of Virtual Paramount, Mornisa could not fight back at all. She was beaten dizzily by Manison's barrage of attacks, and the pain in her mind almost stopped working. Her Virtual Soul flickered like white noise, appearing very unstable.

"Arghhh!"

Mornisa screamed in pain. Although she was mentally prepared to be beaten up by Manison, the pain of having her consciousness heavily damaged was still unbearable. She could feel the strong killing intent in Manison's attacks.

This pain reminded her of the lesson Manison gave her when she failed to steal his technology for the first time.

Back then, Mornisa had just become a Beyond Grade A, and she was extremely proud. She was not clear about the strength of a senior Beyond Grade A yet. After she failed to steal his technology, she was tortured by Manison. All her resistance was futile. She was as helpless as she was now, being tortured like a doll.

At that time, Manison adjusted her understanding of reality, and the deep fear forced Mornisa into the arms of the Radiant Federation.

This humiliating memory had always been suppressed in her heart. At this moment, the shadow in her heart was reawakened. Mornisa could almost feel her soul trembling instinctively. She gritted her teeth and endured the torture, praying that Manison would end it quickly.

After who knew how long, Mornisa, who was enduring bitterly, suddenly felt her mind lighten. She left the Virtual Paramount and returned to the battlefield of the Virtual Intrusion.

Mornisa's mind almost collapsed. Although the actual control time was very short, she felt like she had been tortured for more than ten years. It was like countless blenders were operating in her brain, turning her brain into a mess.

In order to continue the invasion, she had no choice but to continue operating her almost frozen mind. She had to stay awake, and the pain increased again.

The moment she left the Virtual Paramount, due to the stiffness in her mind, her computing power plummeted, and the invasion of the area she was in charge of slowed down.

Taking advantage of this short moment, Manison, who was prepared for this, suddenly released a huge amount of data, trying to break through the information blockade and send it to the outside world.

Hum!

At the edge of this virtual battlefield, layers of light screens suddenly lit up. The main artificial intelligences of the three Universal Civilizations formed a data blocking barrier, cutting off the data sent to the outside world. When this huge number of data Veda hit the blocking barrier, it was like a sky full of mosquitoes hitting a high-voltage grid. With a series of crackling sounds, they instantly exploded into nothingness.

"Cough cough, you want to send a message while I'm injured? How will I let you succeed? I expected this …" Mornisa was still weak, but seeing this scene, she still laughed mockingly.

Manison's face, Virtual Paramount's Virtual Paramount, while resisting the invasion, he tried to send messages to the outside world through the three Universal Civilizations' main artificial intelligence's.

With his Virtual Technology, it was basically impossible for the enemy to completely lock him down, but it would take some time for him to break through the blockade.

Mornisa endured the discomfort in her mind and intercepted a message sent to the outside world. The content was a request for help from the Beyond Grade A Association.

Seeing this, even though she was injured, she could not help but laugh mockingly.

"The once mighty Mecha Empire has finally learned to ask for help, huh? Where's your pride?"

Manison glanced at her, unmoved.

He knew that after he sent out this request for help, it would most likely be Black Star, and he would probably be mocked.

If possible, he did not want to have anything to do with Han Xiao, let alone let Han Xiao visit his database. After all, (Virtual Purification-Restore) was his nemesis. However, in this situation, it was very difficult for him to hold on, so he could only put down his pride and ask for help.

One side was resisting and asking for help, while the other side was invading and blocking. The situation was in a stalemate for quite some time.

Manison kept mending the firewall, but the defense line continued to shrink. Mornisa's group and the three Universal Civilizations' main artificial intelligences squeezed in crazily. More and more invasion probes pierced into the databases, copying and stealing the information he had accumulated over the years.

During this time, Virtual Paramount's cooldown was also reset a few times. Manison used all of them on Mornisa, chasing after her and beating her until she cried out in pain.

Mornisa could not recommend Manison to beat up her teammates, so she could only bear it herself. Her injuries worsened step by step. If not for her teammates' help, her consciousness would not have been able to continue invading.

Suddenly, a wave of data finally broke through the firewall and pierced into the confidential database. It only lasted for an instant before it was killed by Manison.

However, in such a short period of time, these highly computational probes had absorbed a large amount of nutrients and sent back a portion of confidential information.

"We've dug up important technical information!" A Mechanic sent a message to his teammate.

"Continue!" Mornisa's severely damaged consciousness suddenly became energized like she had been injected with chicken blood.

This was like digging deep into a mine and finally finding a gem. Even if she was tortured, it was worth it!

However, at this time, Manison, who had remained calm, finally found a gap in the barrier and sent out the request for help.

"Sh * t, he found a gap and sent it out!"

Mornisa's happiness only lasted for a few seconds. Her heart sank, and she could no longer be happy.

Although she sounded arrogant, she was actually a little panicked. If the association's Mechanics came to help, this operation would be ruined.

This was especially true for the unfathomable Black Star. He was someone who had kicked her teacher, whom she used to respect, off the peak. Just thinking about it made her very wary.

If Black Star came, Mornisa would run away without saying anything. She dared to stab Manison in the back, but she did not dare touch Black Star's butt.

"Don't panic, we still have some time," her teammate said with a deep voice.

Mornisa calmed herself down, clenched her teeth, and activated her computing power, trying to dig up as much technology as possible before the reinforcements arrived. At the same time, she removed most of the computing power that the three Universal Civilizations' main artificial intelligences used to block the news.

Since Manison's request for help had already been sent out, there was no need to spend so much effort to block it. They might as well focus all their computing power on hacking.

In their anxiety, they increased the speed of their hacking. Wave after wave of hacking probes were inserted into the various important databases. Manison frowned and could only try his best to resist.

This lasted for a while. One of the direct Mechanics calculated the time and suddenly said, "It's almost time.

If we delay any longer, the reinforcements will really come. "

"Retreat!"

Mornisa clenched her teeth. They were far from digging out all of Manison's information, but she did not dare delay any longer.

Looking at Manison's broken firewall with reluctance, they retracted their computing power and retreated along the path.

At this time, Manison's Virtual Paramount finished turning. Before this group of intruders escaped, it dealt Mornisa one last blow.

Mornisa was shocked. Her Virtual Soul became fainter, and she used the last bit of her consciousness to leave.

In the Virtual Brainwave Amplifier somewhere in the Primeval Star River, their consciousnesses returned to their avatars.

"Quick, let's go. My mind can't take it anymore …"

Mornisa only managed to say one sentence before her avatar fell to the ground, and the Lord's Descent state was automatically deactivated.

She had been caught and beaten up by Manison, and she was already at the end of her rope. Now that she relaxed, she could not take it anymore. Her consciousness returned to her main body automatically, and she almost fainted … She would probably need at least a year to recover from this round of injuries.

Judith glanced at her avatar that had lost control, shook his head, and said, "Don't worry about her. Take the data we stole and retreat first. The Mecha Empire might catch up at any time."

Everyone nodded and immediately activated the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device.

With a buzzing sound, the two star rings with the Virtual Brainwave Amplifier started to rotate faster and faster, turning into a spherical phantom.

The next moment, a light flashed, and the entire Virtual Brainwave Amplifier was teleported away. The Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device immediately self-destructed and exploded.

…

On the other side, in the Virtual World, Manison silently looked at the battlefield that had been ravaged by the enemy.

"Calculate the data loss and give me a report."

"… Understood."

The main artificial intelligence responded and started to search the various databases.

Very soon, a list was calculated.

Manison looked at the tragic statistics, helplessly closed his eyes, and sighed in his heart. He had a self-deprecating expression on his face.

How could one not wet one's shoes if one always walked by the river? Today, one was being pecked in the eye by the wild goose … It was indeed karma.

About seventy to eighty percent of the information stored in the database had been stolen. This was the information that he had accumulated after many years of monitoring the various organizations. Many of them were confidential documents, especially those of the Supercluster Civilizations in the Primeval Star River.

Many of the technical blueprints that had been accumulated over many years had also been stolen. The only good news was that the core technologies of the Felons and the Indestructible Mecha Empire were all in his mind and not in the database. Otherwise, the losses would have been even greater.

Hum!

At this moment, a stream of data appeared out of nowhere and turned into the figure of a person. He looked down at the mess on the ground and clicked his tongue in wonder.

"Yo, this scene is really fresh. The Mecha Empire that once went around invading others had its database destroyed. Every dog has its day."

Manison looked up. Who else could it be other than Black Star?

He was not in the mood to care about Han Xiao's teasing.

He said calmly, "You're late.

"I don't have telepathy, and I'm already fast enough. You should say that the enemy ran away in time."

Han Xiao landed in front of Manison, looked around, stroked his chin, and asked curiously, "How many people did they send?

"How many people did they send to make you like this?"

"A few direct Mechanics and the main artificial intelligences of the three Universal Civilizations," Manison gave a simple explanation.

"Woah, then they really do value you quite a bit."

Han Xiao raised his brows.

In such a situation, even he did not have the confidence to withstand it. After all, the Indestructible Body was not very useful in the Virtual Technology level, so it was not surprising that Manison was heavily injured.

Manison clicked his tongue. "If I used force, I would have dealt with them by now."

Although he was also good at fighting in the Virtual Technology level, his strength could not be compared to his overall strength. After all, Virtual Technology was an independent ability, and the Mech Legion was not very useful in the Virtual Technology level. Otherwise, with his wealth, he could have easily defeated these invaders in the real world.

In the real world, he and Black Star could fight ten enemies at once, but in the Virtual World, no one could maintain such a shocking ratio.

Han Xiao shook his head and asked, "What do you think?

What do you want to do next? Swallow this or fight back? "

Manison glanced at him and said concisely, "It's up to you."

"Up to me?" Han Xiao was stunned.

"Aren't you the president of the Beyond Grade A Association? I'm also a member of the association. I'll do whatever you say."

"… Who are you? Spit out the real Manison! "

Han Xiao was shocked.

What the hell? You've suffered such a huge loss, but instead of fighting back on your own initiative, you're respecting my opinion as the president? This is not like you, old Manison!

It's over. Either this b * stard's soul has been swapped, or his personality has been distorted due to the huge blow!

Looking at Han Xiao's incredulous expression, Manison only felt annoyed.

"What's with that look? What's so strange about it? Anyway, I'll listen to your opinion on this matter. "

Of course, Manison was not happy about his database being invaded, but he was not too angry. He said that he had to take revenge.

Firstly, the loss was not a big deal to him. The core technical information was all in his mind and had not been leaked. Secondly, the situation was sensitive now. He had to consider the big picture and did not want to disrupt the pace of the game between the association and the three Universal Civilizations.

Although he had suffered a loss this time, it was the three Universal Civilizations working together after all, so the standard was high enough. Manison did not have much of a temper. Furthermore, ever since his position in the Machinery Faith was taken away by Black Star, his demand for Reputation had become lower and lower. He felt that he had become more and more of a Buddhist, no longer clinging to the halo of the number one Mechanic in the galaxy. After all, it did not belong to him anymore.

Maybe it's because I'm getting older. My temper is getting smaller and smaller …

Manison sighed to himself.

"You've really changed …" Han Xiao could not help but sigh. He then said with a straight face, "Don't worry. The three Universal Civilizations have invaded the personal property of an association member. This matter will definitely not end here."

"What are you going to do?"

"Hmm, condemn them first, ask the three Universal Civilizations for an explanation, and see what they have to say."

"They'll just accuse me of stealing the Radiant Federation's secrets and say that this is a reasonable settlement."

Manison shook his head.

"Oh, this is indeed a good reason. Anyway, you're in the wrong, and they're in the right. This way, the problem will return to the association … The three Universal Civilizations are testing you at this juncture."

Han Xiao pondered and said, "The three Universal Civilizations' settlement is just a settlement.

"The so-called 'cleansing' of the three Universal Civilizations is probably just a side benefit. On one hand, they're testing whether the association will take any further actions to counter you, to see what we're capable of. If we only condemn them but do not take action, it'll be a sign of weakness, and the degree to which we take action will reflect how confident we are.

On the other hand, they'll continue to attack the association. They're in the right. If the association stands up for you, it'll seem overbearing and highlight their 'righteousness'. If they don't stand up for you, the association members will feel uneasy and resentful, which is not good for unity. "

Hearing this, Manison nodded in agreement.

The three Universal Civilizations made a move on the association's core members during this sensitive period, so their intentions were obvious. However, the association had no choice but to take action.

However, at this moment, Han Xiao changed the topic.

"However … the premise of this analysis is that we don't consider a huge variable. If this variable appears, the three Universal Civilizations' reaction will not be what I just described."

"What variable?" Manison frowned.

Han Xiao glanced at him and said, "I'll ask you a question.

"Let me ask you a question, and you have to answer me truthfully … Is the Virtual Mutiny Virus technology that you secretly created in the lost data?"

Manison was not mentally prepared and was stunned.

Then, his expression changed, and he stared at Han Xiao in confusion.

When the f * ck did you know my secret?

Thank you for the short and powerless leather armor, the 10000 reward that everyone knows!

(End of Chapter)
